name: Acherontic-Campanile

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed glass plains from ancient cataclysm in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
Vacuous air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on uranium, platinum, salvageable alloys and silicon are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
